Deploy the synthetic Queueable class at API 67.0 in a fresh scratch org and enqueue distinct jobs. Create a second standard synthetic user. For each API version and each of UserId and AsyncApexJobId, create an ApexTestRunResult through the data API, supplying a fresh job, a valid user, ClassesEnqueued=1, ClassesCompleted=1, TestTime=1, start and end timestamps, and Status=Completed. Compare omission of the target ID with a control supplying it. Use a separate job for each populated request. The output is a creation boundary, not an ordering capture.
